description:
We are a team participating in the Casablanca Local Event for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We have chosen the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge because we want to build practical, data-driven solutions to help agriculture adapt to a changing climate.

Why NEX TERRA? We are passionate about using NASA's open data to solve real-world problems. We value quick decision-making, efficient teamwork, and creating a project we are proud to present.

We are ready to build! 🌱🛰️
